description: This file contains Python script code for processing and translating web test files, specifically for updating WebGL conformance tests by modifying HTML content and includes.

methods.name: remove_first_line_comment
methods.description: Removes the first line comment from the input text using regex.

methods.name: translate_includes
methods.description: Replaces specific filenames in the text with relative paths based on a mapping.

methods.name: translate_khronos_test
methods.description: Applies a sequence of translation functions to convert Khronos test content to WebKit test format.

methods.name: update_file
methods.description: Reads an input file, processes its content, and writes the translated content to an output directory.

methods.name: update_directory
methods.description: Processes all HTML files in a directory, updating each.

methods.name: default_out_dir
methods.description: Returns the current working directory as default output directory.

methods.name: configure_logging
methods.description: Sets up logging configuration based on verbosity options.

methods.name: option_parser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for script execution, handling argument parsing and invoking update functions.
